name: qawolf
description: Ask QA Wolf for test coverage, run flows, read results, and drive a cloud browser from your editor.

interface.shortDescription: Request, run, and debug end-to-end tests without leaving the editor
interface.longDescription: QA Wolf writes and maintains end-to-end tests for your application. This plugin gives your coding agent the QA Wolf public API as tools: ask for coverage of a user journey in plain language, run existing flows against an environment, read what failed and why, manage environment variables and issues, and drive a live cloud browser to reproduce a problem.
defaultPrompt: Ask QA Wolf to cover the checkout journey in this repository
Run the smoke-tagged QA Wolf flows and summarize what failed
Open a QA Wolf browser and reproduce the login bug
